About the Scholarship

GLOBE is the Erasmus Mundus master in global studies run jointly by Leipzig, Vienna and Wrocław universities, now open for its third edition (2027-2029). Applications run from 28 September 2026 to 4 January 2027, and a B2 English level must already be demonstrated by the Stage 1 deadline.

OpportunityGLOBE – Erasmus Mundus Master in Global Studies
HostGLOBE Consortium
LocationLeipzig (multi-country mobility), Germany
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students in the
Application Deadline4 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

GLOBE is the Erasmus Mundus master in global studies run jointly by Leipzig, Vienna and Wrocław universities, now open for its third edition (2027-2029). Applications run from 28 September 2026 to 4 January 2027, and a B2 English level must already be demonstrated by the Stage 1 deadline.

Programme Highlights

  • Three-university core (Leipzig, Vienna, Wrocław) with global mobility options
  • Stage 1 deadline of 4 January 2027; window opened 28 September 2026
  • B2 English evidence required by the Stage 1 date
  • Fully funded Erasmus Mundus places for the new edition

Who Should Apply

Graduates in social sciences, humanities, economics and area studies with a globalisation focus; the consortium reviews academic fit closely in Stage 1.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students in the 3rd edition (2027-2029): participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply on the GLOBE application page before 4 January 2027 and secure English evidence early. Key deadline information: 4 January 2027 (Stage 1 deadline); application period 28 September 2026 – 4 January 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About GLOBE Consortium

The GLOBE consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Global Studies across Leipzig, Vienna and Wrocław with global associated partners.

Official website: https://globe-master.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 4 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
